## Why it matters

The Karlsruher Virtueller Katalog is a metasearch tool that queries many library and book trade catalogs from a single interface.

It helps researchers identify editions, compare holdings across institutions, and quickly locate printed material relevant to medieval, modern, and contemporary topics.
